job.job_description:
Design, develop, and optimize highly scalable, secure, and resilient distributed systems using cloud-native technologies, microservices architecture, Kubernetes, containers, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Drive High-Level Design (HLD) and solution architecture discussions, translating business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready technical solutions.
Build and deploy GenAI-powered applications leveraging LLM serving frameworks, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG/GraphRAG), and agent orchestration.
Develop intelligent agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic framework incorporating MCP, tool-calling, OAuth authentication, and enterprise security best practices.
Apply strong Data Structures & Algorithms knowledge and distributed systems expertise to solve complex technical challenges and optimize system performance.
Collaborate closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Owners, and Application Development teams to enable seamless AI solution integration and workflow onboarding.
Design and maintain data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integrations across SQL, NoSQL, and graph databases while implementing MLOps and DevOps best practices, including IaC, CI/CD, monitoring, governance, and platform standardization.
Drive innovation through proactive problem-solving, technical leadership, code/design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability, performance, scalability, and security.
